compos.summarization:
This smartphone UI screen is from a website named "Ver TV Online" and it is displaying a blog post titled "Assistir filmes online" (Watch movies online). The post was published on December 29, 2015, by someone named Andre and has 27 comments. 

The main content of the post informs users about a new online movie application. It mentions that the content is still being added, but users can already watch some movies. There is a link provided for downloading the application, labeled "Baixar catfilmes sofilmes aqui" (Download catfilms sofilms here).

Additionally, the post encourages users to share the application on social media platforms like Google+ and Facebook, or to leave a comment below. There are also social media sharing buttons visible next to the post. The top of the screen includes a navigation bar with a menu button and the website's logo.
